cards.visible_setting: An apartment doorway with a slim exit console, one empty key hook, and two pairs of shoes angled toward the open door.
cards.observable_action: The woman moves a wallet and keyring into the man's already-open jacket pocket while the man lowers a capped water bottle into the woman's already-open tote as both step toward the exit.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand holds the wallet at the pocket opening and her left holds the tote strap; the man's left hand holds the bottle above the tote opening and his right touches the exterior door handle. All four wrists and forearms are visible and separate.
cards.gaze: Both look toward the exit or their next movement rather than at each other.
cards.body_blocking: The woman stands left/front and the slightly taller man stands right/behind; both sets of feet point through the doorway and the two arm actions occur at different heights.
cards.object_state: Wallet and keyring are entering the man's pocket; water bottle is entering the woman's tote; the key hook is empty.
cards.camera_view: Medium-wide three-quarter view from inside at waist height, with both faces and both exchanges visible.
cards.visible_continuity: The wallet, keyring, bottle, tote, doorway, lock, and empty key hook are all simultaneously visible in this frame.

cards.visible_setting: The same kind of apartment or building threshold, viewed from just outside; a helmet hook is visible inside.
cards.observable_action: The woman has one foot outside, holds a phone at her ear with its screen hidden, raises her other palm toward someone outside the frame, and turns back toward the man. The man stands several feet inside holding two helmets and makes a low open-hand gesture.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's left hand owns the phone and her right makes the pause gesture; the man's right holds both helmet straps and his left remains open at waist level. No one touches the other.
cards.gaze: The woman and man look at each other across the doorway.
cards.body_blocking: Her forward step has paused at the threshold; he stands relaxed inside and does not block the exit.
cards.object_state: Phone screen faces inward; both helmets are together in the man's hand.
cards.camera_view: Over the woman's shoulder from outside, with the doorway creating foreground-to-midground depth.
cards.visible_continuity: The doorway, paired helmets, outward step, and hidden phone screen keep the action inside one clearly readable exit-and-transport context.

cards.visible_setting: A hallway wall seen from an adjacent doorway, with one small painter's-tape mark.
cards.observable_action: The man holds a small blank frame flush to the wall while the woman stands about four feet back, squints at it, and pinches two fingers to indicate a tiny sideways adjustment.
cards.hands_and_contact: Both of the man's hands grip the exterior side rails of the frame; the woman's right hand makes the pinch gesture and her left rests at her hip.
cards.gaze: Both look at the slightly tilted blank frame.
cards.body_blocking: The man is in profile close to the wall; the woman is in opposing profile at a judging distance.
cards.object_state: The frame is blank, slightly tilted, and aligned near an earlier tape mark.
cards.camera_view: Wide profile view that shows the full distance between both people and the frame.
cards.visible_continuity: Daylight, different clothes, the hallway wall, blank frame, and painter's-tape mark make this a self-contained domestic setup.

cards.visible_setting: An apartment landing with a matte door already slightly ajar, a narrow wedge of warm interior light, a lock, shallow ledge, and two helmets resting together.
cards.observable_action: The man freezes at the lock holding the bow half of a freshly snapped key a few centimetres from the lock while the metal shaft remains embedded.
cards.hands_and_contact: Only his right hand is visible holding the detached key bow; his left arm is outside the crop.
cards.gaze: He looks directly at the embedded key shaft.
cards.body_blocking: He remains upright in profile with one shoulder raised; his body contour stays visibly separate from the door and frame.
cards.object_state: The key is visibly in two separated pieces; the shaft remains embedded in the lock, the door is already slightly ajar, and both helmets sit on the ledge.
cards.camera_view: Low lock-level close profile with the lock sharp in the foreground and his face readable behind it.
cards.visible_continuity: The already-ajar door, narrow light wedge, lock, ledge, helmets, broken-key pieces, evening light, and his clothes establish one traceable incident state.

cards.visible_setting: The same apartment landing, already-ajar door with warm light wedge, lock, ledge, helmets, and evening light.
cards.observable_action: The woman holds an open tote and searches inside while the man aims a phone torch with its screen turned inward at the key shaft still embedded in the lock.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's left hand holds the tote mouth and her right forearm enters the open bag with its wrist visible; the man's right owns the phone and his left displays the detached key bow in an open palm.
cards.gaze: The woman looks into the tote while the man looks at the lock.
cards.body_blocking: Both stay upright on opposite sides of the lock and lean slightly toward it; their shoulders nearly meet.
cards.object_state: The shaft remains embedded, the detached bow is in the man's palm, the tote is open, and the phone torch lights the lock.
cards.camera_view: High three-quarter view showing the two subtasks, narrowed body distance, bag, light beam, and lock.
cards.visible_continuity: The same clothes, already-ajar door, light wedge, landing, embedded shaft, detached bow, helmets, and tote remain visible.

cards.visible_setting: The same apartment landing and already-ajar door with the damaged lock, viewed from ledge height.
cards.observable_action: The woman holds small closed pliers downward while the man holds a phone face-in at chest level; both speak toward each other with open free hands.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right owns the closed pliers and her left is open at waist height; the man's left owns the phone and his right is open at waist height. No hand points at or touches the other person.
cards.gaze: They make direct eye contact with equally tense expressions.
cards.body_blocking: A two-to-three-foot gap has opened between them; their feet angle slightly away while their torsos remain turned toward the exchange.
cards.object_state: The detached key bow now rests on the ledge; the shaft remains embedded; pliers and phone present two different tools.
cards.camera_view: Low-medium two-shot that keeps both faces, all four hands, the ledge, and the lock visible.
cards.visible_continuity: The same evening clothes, already-ajar door, warm light wedge, damaged lock, key pieces, ledge, helmets, pliers, and phone remain traceable.

cards.visible_setting: The same apartment doorway remains visibly ajar toward the landing and stairwell, with the same warm light wedge and damaged lock.
cards.observable_action: The man crosses the threshold toward the stairs with a helmet while the woman stays inside and half-raises a hand; his leading foot continues outward but his head and shoulders turn back toward her.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand is half-raised and her left is outside the frame; the man's left owns the helmet strap and his right holds the snapped-key bow at thigh level.
cards.gaze: Their eyes reconnect across the doorway.
cards.body_blocking: Both of the woman's feet remain inside; the man is one pace outside with his lower body pointed away and upper body turning back. They do not approach or touch.
cards.object_state: Door is open; helmet and key fragment travel with the man; tote remains inside.
cards.camera_view: Wide view from inside toward the landing, using the doorway and stairs for depth.
cards.visible_continuity: The unchanged clothes, already-ajar door, damaged lock, helmet, key fragment, tote, landing, and evening light keep the incident physically continuous.

cards.visible_setting: The same open doorway with a shallow catchall just inside and the stairs beyond.
cards.observable_action: The man places the snapped-key bow flat into the catchall with his right hand rather than handing it to the woman; a small fresh nick is already visible on that right thumb while she watches without reaching.
cards.hands_and_contact: Only the man's two hands are visible: his right places the fragment with its nicked thumb clear beside the metal, and his left continues holding the helmet. Both of the woman's hands remain outside the crop. No hands touch.
cards.gaze: The woman looks down at his key hand; the man looks at the catchall.
cards.body_blocking: His stair-facing foot still points away, her weight stays rearward inside, and three to four feet remain between them.
cards.object_state: The key fragment moves from the man's nicked right hand to a fixed place inside; the helmet stays in his left hand.
cards.camera_view: Low side-medium view at catchall height with the key placement in the foreground and both profiles behind it.
cards.visible_continuity: The unchanged clothes, doorway, catchall, key fragment, helmet, newly visible right-thumb nick, tense body distance, and her lowered gaze keep the object and relationship state traceable.

cards.visible_setting: A neutral warm-ivory threshold with a soft evening doorway-light wash and one faint door edge at the far outer frame, fully separated from both silhouettes; no furniture or competing prop appears.
cards.observable_action: The woman uses her only visible right thumb and index finger to pinch one loose thin tissue by one corner and dab it against the already-seen 3-mm red nick just below the man's right thumbnail.
cards.hands_and_contact: Exactly two visible arms and hands fill the lower-center evidence zone: each right arm stays continuously traceable from shoulder through bent elbow and wrist to hand. The woman pinches one tissue corner; the man presents a half-open hand with thumb uppermost. Both left arms, waists, and pockets remain entirely outside the crop.
cards.gaze: Both look at the nick and tissue rather than at each other.
cards.body_blocking: They stand upright on the same plane and camera depth, 12–14 inches apart, with equal head scale and the man's crown only one-fifth of a head higher. Both keep closed lips and tightened brows while looking down, with no hug, lean, caress, hand-hold, or smile.
cards.object_state: Exactly one loose thin white facial tissue touches the right thumb; the non-graphic 3-mm red nick remains clearly visible just below the thumbnail. No key, catchall, helmet, phone, or second object appears.
cards.camera_view: Eye-level tight two-shot from both crowns to lower ribs, above every waist and pocket, with both bent right elbows inside frame; clear three-quarter faces remain visible while the tissue-thumb contact is the largest sharp lower-center detail.
cards.visible_continuity: The nick introduced on the man's right thumb in the prior card remains visible at the tissue contact; the same evening clothes, threshold light, equal camera depth, and unreconciled expressions carry through.

cards.visible_setting: The apartment doorway and first stair turn viewed from a high ceiling corner.
cards.observable_action: The woman steps back inside while the man continues down the stairs in the opposite direction.
cards.hands_and_contact: The woman's right hand holds a face-down phone and her left is out of view; the man's left hand owns the helmet and his right thumb carries the tissue.
cards.gaze: At most one small head-turn connects them; neither faces the camera or holds a posed gaze.
cards.body_blocking: Their bodies travel along different paths separated by the doorway and stair geometry without a graphic divider.
cards.object_state: The key fragment stays in the catchall inside; the tissue travels on the man's thumb; the phone screen stays hidden.
cards.camera_view: High extreme-wide view showing both trajectories, doorway, catchall, and stair turn.
cards.visible_continuity: The evening clothes and light remain unchanged while the key fragment stays inside and the helmet and accepted tissue travel downstairs with the man.

cards.visible_setting: The apartment doorway the next morning, matched to the first card, with the same console and key hook.
cards.observable_action: In new clothes, the woman moves the man's wallet into his open jacket pocket while the man lowers her filled water bottle into the open tote as both walk toward the doorway.
cards.hands_and_contact: Only the two active hands are visible: her right hand owns the wallet and his left owns the bottle; both wrists and forearms remain traceable with one clear front/behind order.
cards.gaze: Neither needs to look at the other or at the exchanged objects.
cards.body_blocking: Their shoulders and feet move in the same direction with a small natural height difference and no embrace or posed stop.
cards.object_state: Wallet and bottle repeat the first exchange; the lock cylinder is clean and replaced, and one fresh working key hangs on the ordinary hook.
cards.camera_view: Wide three-quarter doorway framing that deliberately matches the first card.
cards.visible_continuity: The reciprocal wallet-and-bottle exchange is visibly repeated in different clothes beside a clean replacement lock and fresh working key; no wedding objects or extra people appear.
